primary.title: Knowing How to Build Something Is Different From Knowing What Should Be Built
primary.summary: Knowing how to build software is not the same as knowing what should be built. On craft, judgment, architecture, and why AI makes that distinction sharper.

primary.title: Enterprise sales teams, please, I beg you, stop
primary.summary: I asked for a price on a few extra seats of software we already pay for. Two days and a pile of irrelevant questions later, I got one.

primary.title: Learning a New Tech Stack with an LLM
primary.summary: While I mentioned a few weeks back that I'm now recovering from AI Psychosis , that doesn't mean I've given up on the technology completely. I'm writing more emails, and engaging with human beings as much as I can, and that part's been great.
